invariants.statement: RepoPact Core is the sole authority for governance semantics, validation, graph, analysis, mutation, and headless engine behavior.
invariants.enforcement: All Core dependencies use one full Git SHA; no copied Core source or parallel semantic implementation is permitted.

invariants.statement: Repository-local and offline operation remains available; remote-provider authentication is optional.
invariants.enforcement: Feature and integration tests exercise local repository workflows without network credentials.

invariants.statement: Secrets stay inside platform-managed credential facilities and do not enter UI bundles, logs, evidence, or artifacts.
invariants.enforcement: Security tests and artifact inspection cover secret-bearing surfaces.

invariants.statement: Security assurance and platform support claims require evidence for the exact target and boundary.
invariants.enforcement: S3 evidence records tested targets and distinguishes untested or unsupported platforms.
